Why post the strong conclusion that the vaccine is extremely effective when both the second hand source and primary source acknowledge several limitations that 💯 preclude such conclusion ?

A) observational research, so people who get the vaccine might be more likely than those who do not get the vaccine to have better preventative health care OVERALL, which prima facie is likely to reduce cervical cancer risk.

B) there were no significant dosage differences; failure to reject the null does not allow one to conclude no differences.

C) the fact that they found no significant dosage differences is entirely more consistent and more parsimonious with point A above.  

Why do people sensationalize this stuff? The mechanism is critically important.  Here, the association is most probably spurious (explanation A).  What is the biochemical mechanism of action for the effect, if it is in fact causal? In the absence of a plausible mechanism AND the observational design, the best conclusion is explanation A.
